description: This file defines a React functional component 'MemberPermissions' that manages and displays team member permissions, including fetching current permissions, editing them via checkboxes, and saving changes. It also includes UI elements like a table, buttons, and notifications.

methods.name: fetchPermissions
methods.description: Fetches permissions data for the team and updates component state.

methods.name: handlePermissionChange
methods.description: Handles updating selected permissions when a checkbox is toggled.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves updated permissions to the backend.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Reloads permissions from the backend, discarding unsaved changes.
